note: To buy or obtain something quickly, especially because it is available for a short time or at a good price.

senses.m: To buy or obtain something quickly, especially because it is available for a short time or at a good price
senses.pat: snap up a bargain · tickets were snapped up · snap something up quickly
ex: Shoppers snapped up the discounted laptops.
Người mua nhanh chóng mua hết các máy tính giảm giá.
The first batch of tickets was snapped up in minutes.
Đợt vé đầu tiên được mua hết chỉ trong vài phút.

note: A tire designed for improved traction in snow or ice; also winter tire, a broader term.

senses.m: A tire designed for improved traction in snow or ice
senses.pat: fit snow tires · a set of snow tires · snow-tire traction
ex: They fitted snow tires before driving into the mountains.
Họ lắp lốp đi tuyết trước khi lái xe lên núi.
Winter tires improve grip in cold conditions.
Lốp mùa đông tăng độ bám trong điều kiện lạnh.

note: A powdered detergent or soap product for washing clothes; usage varies and may refer to traditional soap-based washing powder.

senses.m: A powdered detergent or soap product for washing clothes
senses.pat: a box of soap powder · dissolve soap powder · use soap powder for laundry
ex: She added soap powder to the washing machine.
Cô cho bột giặt vào máy giặt.
The instructions say to dissolve the soap powder first.
Hướng dẫn yêu cầu hòa tan bột giặt trước.

note: A political tradition supporting democratic government, social welfare, and regulation of a market economy; meanings and party platforms vary.

senses.m: A political tradition supporting democratic government, social welfare, and regulation of a market economy
senses.pat: social-democratic policies · social democracy movement · a social-democratic party
ex: The party’s platform is rooted in social democracy.
Cương lĩnh của đảng dựa trên tư tưởng dân chủ xã hội.
The debate compared social democracy with liberalism.
Cuộc tranh luận so sánh dân chủ xã hội với chủ nghĩa tự do.

note: A scholar who studies society and human behavior in fields such as sociology, economics, or political science.

senses.m: A scholar who studies society and human behavior in fields such as sociology, economics, or political science
senses.pat: a social scientist studies · social-science research · consult a social scientist
ex: The social scientist interviewed residents about housing.
Nhà khoa học xã hội phỏng vấn cư dân về nhà ở.
Social scientists analyzed the survey results.
Các nhà khoa học xã hội phân tích kết quả khảo sát.

note: A device that converts light directly into electricity through the photovoltaic effect; also photovoltaic cell.

senses.m: A device that converts light directly into electricity through the photovoltaic effect
senses.pat: a solar cell converts light · solar-cell efficiency · silicon solar cell
ex: Each solar cell converts sunlight into electrical energy.
Mỗi tế bào quang điện chuyển ánh nắng thành điện năng.
The panel contains dozens of solar cells.
Tấm pin có hàng chục tế bào quang điện.

note: A pressure disturbance that travels through a medium such as air, liquid, or solid; sound cannot travel through a vacuum.

senses.m: A pressure disturbance that travels through a medium such as air, liquid, or solid
senses.pat: sound waves travel · frequency of a sound wave · sound-wave energy
ex: A sound wave travels through air to the listener’s ear.
Sóng âm truyền qua không khí đến tai người nghe.
The experiment measured sound waves in water.
Thí nghiệm đo sóng âm trong nước.

note: A place where free or low-cost meals are served to people in need; often run by charities or community groups.

senses.m: A place where free or low-cost meals are served to people in need
senses.pat: volunteer at a soup kitchen · serve meals at · local soup kitchen
ex: Volunteers served hot meals at the soup kitchen.
Tình nguyện viên phục vụ bữa ăn nóng tại bếp ăn từ thiện.
The community opened a soup kitchen during the winter.
Cộng đồng mở bếp ăn từ thiện trong mùa đông.

note: Human-readable instructions written in a programming language before compilation or execution; license terms govern copying and reuse.

senses.m: Human-readable instructions written in a programming language before compilation or execution
senses.pat: read/edit source code · source-code repository · open-source code
ex: The developer reviewed the source code before release.
Lập trình viên xem lại mã nguồn trước khi phát hành.
The project publishes its source code under an open license.
Dự án công bố mã nguồn theo giấy phép mở.

note: A program in its original source-code form, before translation into machine code or another executable form.

senses.m: A program in its original source-code form, before translation into machine code or another executable form
senses.pat: compile a source program · source-program file · translate the source program
ex: The compiler checked the source program for errors.
Trình biên dịch kiểm tra chương trình nguồn để tìm lỗi.
The source program was saved separately from the executable.
Chương trình nguồn được lưu riêng với tệp thực thi.

note: A country at the southern end of the African continent; its official name is the Republic of South Africa.

senses.m: A country at the southern end of the African continent
senses.pat: in South Africa · South African culture · travel to South Africa
ex: Cape Town is a city in South Africa.
Cape Town là một thành phố ở Nam Phi.
South Africa has several official languages.
Nam Phi có một số ngôn ngữ chính thức.

note: The Republic of Korea, a country in East Asia occupying the southern part of the Korean Peninsula.

senses.m: The Republic of Korea, a country in East Asia occupying the southern part of the Korean Peninsula
senses.pat: in South Korea · South Korean government · travel to South Korea
ex: The conference will take place in South Korea.
Hội nghị sẽ diễn ra tại Hàn Quốc.
South Korea is known officially as the Republic of Korea.
Tên chính thức của Hàn Quốc là Đại Hàn Dân Quốc.

note: Relating to South Korea or a person from there; use a specific regional or personal identity when known.

senses.m: Relating to South Korea or a person from there
senses.pat: South Korean film · a South Korean citizen · South Korean company
ex: The festival screened a South Korean film.
Liên hoan chiếu một bộ phim Hàn Quốc.
She is a South Korean researcher working in Seoul.
Cô là nhà nghiên cứu Hàn Quốc làm việc tại Seoul.

note: The aurora australis: colored light displays near the southern magnetic pole caused by charged particles interacting with the upper atmosphere.

senses.m: The aurora australis: colored light displays near the southern magnetic pole caused by charged particles interacting with the upper atmosphere
senses.pat: see the southern lights · southern-lights display · photograph the aurora australis
ex: The ship’s passengers saw the southern lights over Antarctica.
Hành khách trên tàu nhìn thấy cực quang phương Nam phía trên Nam Cực.
Clear skies helped them photograph the aurora australis.
Trời quang giúp họ chụp được cực quang phương Nam.

note: A police unit responsible for national security or political intelligence; the title is especially associated with historical British and Commonwealth policing.

senses.m: A police unit responsible for national security or political intelligence
senses.pat: the Special Branch investigates · Special Branch officer · refer a case to Special Branch
ex: Special Branch investigated threats to public officials.
Cục đặc nhiệm điều tra các mối đe dọa nhằm vào quan chức.
The novel features a Special Branch detective.
Cuốn tiểu thuyết có một thám tử thuộc lực lượng đặc nhiệm.

note: A professional who assesses and treats speech, language, communication, or swallowing difficulties; also speech-language therapist/pathologist depending on country.

senses.m: A professional who assesses and treats speech, language, communication, or swallowing difficulties
senses.pat: see a speech therapist · speech-therapy session · speech therapist for children
ex: The child worked with a speech therapist twice a week.
Đứa trẻ làm việc với chuyên viên âm ngữ trị liệu hai lần mỗi tuần.
A speech therapist helped him regain communication skills.
Chuyên viên âm ngữ trị liệu giúp anh phục hồi kỹ năng giao tiếp.

note: A place where police monitor vehicle speeds and issue tickets; sometimes implies the limit is unexpectedly low or enforcement is hidden.

senses.m: A place where police monitor vehicle speeds and issue tickets
senses.pat: a speed trap on the highway · get caught in a speed trap · speed-trap camera
ex: Drivers slowed down near the speed trap.
Tài xế giảm tốc gần điểm kiểm tra tốc độ.
The town denied that its speed camera was a speed trap.
Thị trấn phủ nhận camera tốc độ của họ là bẫy phạt.

note: Money available for personal or discretionary purchases, separate from essential expenses; often given to a child or traveler.

senses.m: Money available for personal or discretionary purchases, separate from essential expenses
senses.pat: give someone spending money · have some spending money · pocket spending money
ex: Her parents gave her spending money for the school trip.
Cha mẹ cho cô tiền tiêu vặt cho chuyến đi của trường.
He saved his spending money for a new camera.
Anh để dành tiền tiêu riêng để mua máy ảnh mới.

note: A long-limbed New World monkey in the genus Ateles, native to Central and South American forests.

senses.m: A long-limbed New World monkey in the genus Ateles, native to Central and South American forests
senses.pat: a spider monkey swings · spider-monkey habitat · a troop of spider monkeys
ex: A spider monkey swung between the trees.
Một con khỉ nhện chuyền giữa các tán cây.
The reserve protects habitat for spider monkeys.
Khu bảo tồn bảo vệ môi trường sống của khỉ nhện.

note: A small burner using alcohol or another spirit as fuel, commonly used in laboratories or for heating small quantities; also alcohol lamp.

senses.m: A small burner using alcohol or another spirit as fuel, commonly used in laboratories or for heating small quantities
senses.pat: light a spirit lamp · a laboratory spirit lamp · extinguish the spirit lamp
ex: The student heated the sample over a spirit lamp.
Học sinh đun nóng mẫu trên đèn cồn.
Extinguish the spirit lamp with its cap after use.
Sau khi sử dụng, đậy nắp để tắt đèn cồn.
